title: Lake sync
description: Is the backend getting OpenF1 data into the lake, and is the live sync healthy? The OpenF1 events in bronze, CDC of LiveSyncState, and the backend's OpenTelemetry metrics, traces and logs.

panels.title: Since last sync run
panels.note: Minutes, from the CDC'd sync state. Above 2 means the scheduled event has stopped.
panels.query: SELECT date_diff('minute', LastRunAt, now()) AS minutes FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate

panels.title: Sync runs per hour
panels.note: Changes to the sync state. About 60 while it runs every minute.
panels.query: SELECT date_trunc('hour', changed_at) AS hour, count(*) AS runs FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate_history WHERE change_op = 'u' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Laps written, last run
panels.note: Flat at 0 during a session is a fault.
panels.query: SELECT changed_at, LapsWritten FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate_history WHERE change_op = 'u' ORDER BY changed_at

panels.title: OpenF1 requests per hour
panels.note: Every feed, from the f1.openf1.requests counter in Sync_Fetch.
panels.query: WITH d AS (SELECT time::TIMESTAMP AS time, attributes, CASE WHEN temporality = 'delta' THEN value WHEN lag(value) OVER w IS NULL OR value < lag(value) OVER w THEN value ELSE value - lag(value) OVER w END AS delta FROM otel.metrics WHERE name = 'f1.openf1.requests' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service_name, CAST(attributes AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY time)) SELECT date_trunc('hour', time) AS hour, sum(delta) AS requests FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Posts to the lake that failed
panels.note: From the backend's f1.lake.post_failures counter, last 24 hours. The sync carries on and retries the next cycle.
panels.query: WITH d AS (SELECT time::TIMESTAMP AS time, CASE WHEN temporality = 'delta' THEN value WHEN lag(value) OVER w IS NULL OR value < lag(value) OVER w THEN value ELSE value - lag(value) OVER w END AS delta FROM otel.metrics WHERE name = 'f1.lake.post_failures' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service_name, CAST(attributes AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY time)) SELECT COALESCE(sum(delta), 0) AS failed FROM d WHERE time > now()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 1 DAY

panels.title: Sync timeline
panels.note: A rate-limit episode shows as retries rising while laps written flattens.

layers.name: laps written
layers.query: SELECT changed_at, LapsWritten FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate_history WHERE change_op = 'u' ORDER BY 1

layers.name: retries
layers.query: WITH d AS (SELECT time::TIMESTAMP AS time, attributes, CASE WHEN temporality = 'delta' THEN value WHEN lag(value) OVER w IS NULL OR value < lag(value) OVER w THEN value ELSE value - lag(value) OVER w END AS delta FROM otel.metrics WHERE name = 'f1.openf1.retries' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service_name, CAST(attributes AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY time)) SELECT date_trunc('minute', time) AS minute, sum(delta) AS retries FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

layers.label: what
layers.query: SELECT changed_at, CASE WHEN Enabled THEN 'switched on' ELSE 'switched off' END AS what FROM (SELECT changed_at, Enabled, lag(Enabled) OVER (ORDER BY changed_at) AS prev FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate_history) WHERE prev IS DISTINCT FROM Enabled ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Requests per feed
panels.note: Per 10 minutes. A feed that drops to zero while the others carry on is a broken endpoint.
panels.query: WITH d AS (SELECT time::TIMESTAMP AS time, attributes, CASE WHEN temporality = 'delta' THEN value WHEN lag(value) OVER w IS NULL OR value < lag(value) OVER w THEN value ELSE value - lag(value) OVER w END AS delta FROM otel.metrics WHERE name = 'f1.openf1.requests' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service_name, CAST(attributes AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY time)) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, time) AS t, attributes['feed'] AS feed, sum(delta) AS requests FROM d GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY t

panels.title: Slowest backend operations, last hour
panels.note: Average span duration in ms, from the runtime's traces.
panels.query: SELECT name, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms FROM otel.spans WHERE service_name = 'Formula1Backend' AND start_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY name ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Last 20 sync results
panels.query: SELECT changed_at, SessionKey, LapsWritten, LastResult FROM formula1backend.livesyncstate_history ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Warnings and errors, last 24 h
panels.query: SELECT time::TIMESTAMP AS time, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'WARNING' END AS level, body, attributes['node'] AS node, service_name FROM otel.logs WHERE severity_number >= 13 AND time > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
panels.note: Mendix sends the level as a number only (OpenTelemetry's scale: 9 INFO, 13 WARN, 17 ERROR, 21 FATAL), so the name is derived here.

panels.title: OpenF1 events into the lake
panels.note: Events per 10 minutes and feed, counted in bronze (topic openf1): what actually arrived. A feed only posts when its response changed, so a quiet feed outside a session is normal; a feed that goes quiet during one is not.
panels.query: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, warpstream.timestamp)::TIMESTAMP AS t, warpstream.headers['ce_type'] AS feed, count(*) AS events FROM main.local__openf1 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY t
